The crowd is going ga-ga over Rahim but I guess the game changed in the second session yesterday when Bangladesh hammered 151 runs in 32 overs. Since then, Zimbabwe have looked deflated and what followed next only rubbed salt on their wounds. Add to it, they became a bowler short when Tendai Chatara got injured this morning.

The story of the first innings actually revolves around 3 players. First, Kyle Jarvis - who rocked the top order and finished with 5 wickets. Second - Mominul Haque who took the bull by the horns with his counter-attack and scored a brilliant 161. And finally, the pocket rocket, Mushfiqur Rahim. He took his time and then went on to score a brilliant 200, the first by anyone in Tests in 2018.

Very good session for Bangladesh. They did not lose a wicket at all in this session. Rahim and Mahmudullah did dig deep and managed to absorb the pressure the Zimbabwe bowlers were creating with the new ball. Coming to the visitors, they did bowl well, but could not get any scalps. Their main worry would be the injury to Tendai Chatara who pulled his muscle while bowling and was stretchered off the field. One good thing for Zimbabwe was that they did not concede too many runs with the run rate being just above 2. Will we see some quick scoring after Lunch? Or will the African side manage to get through their Bangladesh's middle order? Do join us for the post-Lunch session in some time.

Now, it is Mominul's turn to have a chat. Feels that the surface is good to bat on. Reckons that both batsmen and bowlers need to have patience to score runs and get wickets. Credits Rahim for maintaining the tempo of the partnership. Like Chakabva, he too, wants to take it session by session. Feels that 450-500 would be a good score on this track and batting only once would be their aim.

Ed Rainsford is having a chat with Regis Chakabva. Regis says that they had a great first session yesterday but admits that they lost the plot in the second. Credits Mominul and Rahim for applying themselves well in the second session against all the pressure, but reckons that Zimbabwe pulled things back in the final session. On his own cricketing experience, Chakabva says that he has been spending time in the UK, improving his skills. On the keeping, he says that it is a tough place to come and keep but feels that he did a decent job yesterday. On  the surface, he says that in the first session, the track spun a bit but in the second, the turn just disappeared. Wants to take it session by session and see how it goes.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo observes that conditions are ideal for playing cricket today. Sees a couple of degradations from yesterday where a few areas have dried up and have been opened up by the bowlers' footmarks. So there will be turn on offer and spin  will play a part later on in the game.
WEATHER REPORT - Bright and sunny conditions to play cricket. Given that winter is setting in, these could be wonderful conditions to play the sport.

After a good day of Test cricket on Day 1, we look forward to Day 2 where both teams would like to get a firm grip of the match. We saw some good cricket from both sides. Earlier in the day, the new cherry did swing and Zimbabwe's new-ball bowlers made full use of it taking three wickets in no time. Then came a mammoth partnership of 266 runs between Mominul Haque and Mushfiqur Rahim which completely changed the dynamics of the game. Both of them scored freely getting hundreds each. Zimbabwe did manage to pull back by taking couple of wickets towards the end though. The home team would be hoping that their experienced players -  Rahim and Mahmudullah, dig deep today and get to a score of around 400 which will be useful on this wicket. On the other hand, Zimbabwe will be looking to wrap up the tail as soon as possible.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

It's time to leave now. Bangladesh will be very pleased after their recovery while Zimbabwe would be ruing the dropped catches. Day 2 promises to be equally entertaining with the second new ball only 6 overs old. Do join us on Monday at 0930 local (0330 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

Zimbabwe were brilliant in the first session but their bowling fell completely flat in the afternoon. They were attacked by the pair of Mominul and Rahim which resulted in the flow of runs at a quick rate. In total 151 runs came from the second session as Bangladesh made a resounding comeback. The tourists though were a lot better in the evening, bowling tidy lines and restricting the run-flow. After toiling hard, they finally managed to remove Mominul Haque soon after taking the second new cherry. The Zimbabwe pacers were very impressive, especially Kyle Jarvis but their spinners failed to leave any impact.

End of an absorbing day of Test cricket! Bangladesh found themselves in an early spot of bother in the morning after losing three quick wickets but then the marathon 266-run partnership between Mominul Haque and Mushfiqur Rahim bailed them out. The former was dropped a couple of times and he made Zimbabwe pay heavily. Mominul went on to stroke a big century and along with Rahim, they put all the pressure on Zimbabwe.

Identical delivery, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
In the channel outside off, Rahim lets it go.
Chatara starts off with a full delivery on off, Rahim defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
And again. Haque stays back footed to play at a delivery on off and gets an inside edge. It deflects behind and rolls to the keeper. Good start by Kyle.
Identical to the last delivery, it's around off and Haque goes back in defense. It takes the inside edge and hits him on the pads.
Fine delivery and it's a good leave as well. On a length just around off, straightening a bit, Mominul takes a stride forward before making a leave.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, too wide actually to make the batsman play.
Good length delivery around off, angling away from the batsman, Mominul covers the line and shoulders arms.
Starts with a delivery down the leg side, Mominul fails to flick and Chakabva does well to stop the ball with a dive to his right.

Back for the last session. 32 overs left in the day's play. The men concerned are back on the field as well. Kyle Jarvis will begin proceedings as Zimbabwe are in a desperate need of a breakthrough. Here we go...
... DAY 1, THIRD SESSION ...

Mominul Hasan was the star of the session as he stroked a fluent century. However, he was given one life post Lunch as well when the wicket-keeper dropped his catch. All in all, he has been dropped twice in this innings and he is making the visitors pay dearly. Mushfiqur Rahim's experienced head has also played a part in this 181-run record partnership and he himself is heading towards a century. Currently, it's advantage Bangladesh but you never know which way the next session will turn. Do join us in a short while to find out.

What a contrasting session! Zimbabwe dominated in the morning by snaffling three wickets by giving away just 56 runs and Bangladesh bounced back in the afternoon to score 151 runs for the loss of zero wickets. Mominul Haque and Mushfiqur Rahim counter-attacked and with the pitch flattening out, there was no resistance for the Zimbabwean bowlers. They were also the culprits of bowling all over the place which resulted in runs coming thick and fast.
Similar delivery, Rahim lets it go to the keeper. And that is Tea on Day 1.
Length delivery outside off, MR shoulders arms to it.
Drifts on to his pads, Haque tucks it behind square leg for a run.
FOUR! STREAKY! Full and wide outside off, Haque slashes hard at it and the ball goes uppishly over gully for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery on off, Haque defends it from within the crease.
Length delivery angling onto his pads, Rahim works it to the on side for a single.
Jumps out of the crease and drives it to mid off for a sharp single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end otherwise it would have been interesting.
On middle, Rahim gets back and keeps it out on the leg side.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it.
Skidding back into the batsman, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a run. 200 comes up for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Wow, what a shot! Mominul is down on one knee to a full ball outside off. He fetches it from there, goes against the spin but powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Nearly went all the way.
Tossed up ball on off, a bit on the shorter side, Haque taps it down towards point and eyes a run. He is sent back.
Full and angling onto the stumps, Rahim flicks it to square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and wide outside off, Haque cuts it hard through backward point for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Haque taps it toward covers.
Length delivery outside off, Haque lets it go.
Starts his new spell with a full delivery on off, Haque leans forward and pushes it toward covers.
Tendai Chatara returns for another spell.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Bowls it short and Rahim pulls it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for one.
Another back foot punch, this time through covers for a run.
Stays back and punches it to covers.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.

FOUR! 7th Test hundred for Mominul Haque. The dry spell is over. The little batsman who once was called the Asian Bradman is back in form. Receives a full toss with open arms and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He was dropped twice in this innings and he has made sure to make it count. Brilliant fightback.
Flighted on middle, Rahim was looking to nudge it wide of square leg. He closes the face of the bat early, leading edge of the bat takes the ball to the off side.
Full on middle, Haque tucks it away to square leg for a single.
Tossed it up on middle, Haque defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and wide outside off, Haque rocks back and slaps it through point for a couple of runs.
Full on middle, Haque drives it to the point fielder.
Tossed it up on middle, Rahim tucks it to the on side for a single.
Fetches a short ball from around off and pulls it with the turn to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Goes on the back foot to a short delivery and slaps it to deep cover for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back off the front foot.
Short in length and outside off, Haque cuts it off his back foot but finds the point fielder.
Well played! Deft. Skidding away from the batsman, around off, Rahim uses the depth of his crease and at the last moment deflects it through backward point for three runs.
Loopy full ball on off, Rahim defends it off his front foot.
Gives a bit of air, Rahim drives it through covers. The batsmen rotate strike.
Drags his length short, Rahim punches it off the back foot.
Wide down leg, the Haque sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Full on middle, Haque drives it to the mid on fielder.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim hangs back and cuts it through backward  point for three runs. Good stop by the point fielder otherwise it was a sure boundary.
Tossed it up on middle, Rahim tucks it to the on side.
Too full in length around leg, Rahim walks forward and forces it down to long on for one.
Flighted and full on off, Rahim presses forward in defense.
Skidding back in from around off, Haque gets back and turns it in the gap at square leg for a run.
Loopy full ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! Moves into the 90s! Once again the length is on the shorter side, around off, Mominul goes deep inside the crease and clobbers it through covers.
FOUR! Raza drops it short first up, a rank loosener, Mominul goes on the back foot and hammer-pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Sikandar Raza is back on.
Slider from Mavuta outside off, Rahim tries to cut but misses it completely. Good delivery to end the over.
Nice loopy delivery on off turning away. Rahim lets it go.
Flighted on middle, Haque gets to the pitch of the ball and tucks it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full on middle, Haque works it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drags his length short, Haque defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! No stopping this one! Williams serves a flat and short delivery on off, Rahim camps back to create some room and slaps it through point for a boundary. Bangladesh continue their merry way. This is now the record 4th wicket partnership for Bangladesh in Tests against Zimbabwe.
Too full and on middle, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Slower through the air on middle, Haque moves back and plays it down to short leg.
Wayward delivery. Short and way down the leg side. Mominul tries pulling at the last moment but misses. Chakabva collects it and then appeals. Nothing from the umpire.
Quicker one fired down the leg side, Rahim failed to sweep and it went of the keeper's pads to short fine leg. They stole a bye.
A low full toss on the pads, it's been easily worked away through the gap at mid-wicket for a run. The partnership continues to blossom.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter in length, Mominul has punched it through point. They get a run.
Tossed up on off, Haque leans forward and pushes it towards the point fielder.
A bit quicker on middle, the batsman defends it from within the crease.
Down the leg side, Mominul plays another sweep fine down the leg side for a brace.
Full on his pads, Haque sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Arm ball around off, skidding away from the left-hander, Haque punches it off his back foot to point and pinches a single.
Short and on off, cut from the back foot to point.
Flatter and wider outside off, Rahim strokes it square of the wicket on the off side and scampers across for a quick single.
Quicker one, fired in on middle, Rahim taps it down in front of short leg.
Angling into the batsman, Rahim once again keeps it out by going deep inside the crease.
Flighted delivery on off, Rahim defends it off his front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Nice shot. Mavuta drags it short again, Haque square cuts it past backward point for a boundary.
Gives a bit of air on middle, Haque defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted on middle, the batsman guides it towards point.
Quicker outside off, Haque tries to late cut it but misses.
Drags it short, Haque cuts it towards point for a couple of runs.
Goes back to a short delivery and pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Another sweep shot attempted by Haque but once again he fails to get the placement right. Straight to short fine leg.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Mominul defends it back off the front foot.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Sliding down the leg side, it's swept well but straight in the direction of the short fine leg fielder.
Tossed up delivery around leg, Haque moves back and takes it on his pads.
Drags it short, Rahim hangs back and cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
Full on his pads, Mominul sweeps it towards fine leg. Batsmen rotate strike.
FOUR! EXQUISITE! Mavuta floats it up on middle, Haque gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it firmly through covers for a boundary. Lovely shot.
Tossed up on middle, Rahim leans forward and guides it to covers for a single.
Half tracker wide outside leg. Rahim tried to pull it but could not connect.
Full on middle, Haque strokes it to long on for a single.
On the pads, tickled away in the gap on the leg side for a run.

Fifty for Rahim, his 20th in Tests! A brilliant knock by the experienced campaigner. He receives a good round of applause from his teammates and the crowd. A hard working knock for him. He reaches there by calmly pushing a full ball in the gap at covers. A vital knock in a crunch situation. Would look to build on this!
Goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Flatter arm ball on off, skidding back in, Rahim gets inside the crease and punches it to covers.
A full toss on the pads, Mominul clips it through square leg and rotates the strike.
Flighted full ball on off, Rahim easily drives it down to long off for a run.
Drinks break.
On middle, Rahim strokes it through covers for a single.
Nicely tossed up by the bowler, MR defends it from within the crease.
Full toss from Mavuta, Haque pulls it through mid wicket. Batsmen rotate strike.
Short in length, Rahim rocks back and cuts it through deep point for a run. Brings up the 100-run stand between these. They have completely dominated the post Lunch session.
Flighted on middle, Haque leans forward and drives it toward mid off for a single.
Starts off with a fuller delivery on middle, Rahim tucks it to the on side for a single.
Time for some leg spin. Brandon Mavuta is given the ball. He bowled brilliantly in the last match.
Goes down on one knee to play the sweep shot but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Another one on the pads, it's nudged behind square leg for a run.
Fires one down the leg side, Rahim fails to get any bat behind it. A good take by Chakabva.
Flatter around off, punched off the back foot to mid on.
Prods forward to a full ball and drives it to short cover.
Full flighted ball on middle, forced down to long on for a run.

Movement back into the batsman. This one cuts back in from around off, Rahim tries defending from the front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Had there been a short leg, it would have been an easy catch for him. But there isn't any and it rolls to square leg.
This one holds a bit off the pitch, around off, Rahim gets behind the line and pushes it to mid off.
Presses forward to a full ball and drops it with soft hands to cover-point. Looks for a run but his partner isn't interested.

FOUR! Edgy but well played! Good length delivery around off, Rahim strides forward to have a push inside the line. He does so with gentle hands and the outside edge races past gully and backward point for a boundary.
Jarvis delivers another length ball outside off, this time Mominul plays it with an open-faced bat and pushes it through the gap at covers for a run.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
On middle, Rahim defends it from within the crease.
Sean bowls a bit quicker on off, MR late cuts it fine toward third man for a couple of runs.
Quicker outside off, Haque pushes it toward the point region. Batsmen rotate strike.
Bowls a bit quicker on off, Rahim drives it to mid off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, the batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flighted on middle, Haque flicks it uppishly but the ball goes wide of the short leg fielder and they get a run.
A yorker on off, well bowled. Rahim also does well to dig it out.
Rahim has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and off, defended from the crease.

Appeal for an lbw! Not given. Jarvis serves an in-dipper. It lands full and nips back in. Rahim tries to defend it with a straight bat but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Jarvis looks at Hamilton and wants it reviewed. Raza also joins the conversation and is supporting the bowler. Masakadza is almost convinced but by that time, 15 seconds are over. The replays after that show that there was a big inside edge. Zimbabwe are lucky.
Short in length on middle, Mominul pulls it through mid-wicket and the ball races through. It slows down though just before the rope and they take three runs.
A length ball angling away from the batsman, Mominul gets forward and defends.
Full on his pads, Haque sweeps it towards fine leg. Batsmen rotate strike. Bangladesh are in control of the game after Lunch.
Tossed up on middle, the batsman watchfully blocks it.

FOUR! Cuts and cuts hard. It's dragged in short, Haque quickly rocks back and cuts it towards backward point for a boundary. Also brings up his 13th Test fifty. Superb knock by the left-hander although he was dropped a couple of times. He needs to carry on and score a big one.
Full on his pads, Haque tickles it fine for a couple of runs.
Quicker outside off, Haque tries to cut but misses it completely.
Flatter in length on middle, Rahim tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Shortish and outside off, Haque cuts but finds the point fielder.
Full in length and outside off, Mominul gets forward confidently and drives it delightfully through covers for a couple of runs. 100 comes up for Bangladesh. It's been a good recovery.
Back of a length delivery on off, Mominul defends it from the crease to covers.
Sliding down the leg side, Rahim clips it through square leg and takes another run in this over.
Once again the length is short from Jarvis and Mominul pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Shortish and on off, Mominul goes on the back foot and taps it down to the off side. The point fielder is quickly to the ball.
Floats it up on middle, Rahim gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards covers. A good stop by the fielder otherwise it would have raced away to the boundary.
Bowls a bit fuller on middle, Haque strokes it to mid on. Batsmen rotate strike.
Flighted delivery on middle and off, MR eases it towards covers for a run.
Sean bangs it short outside off, Rahim rocks back and cuts it straight to the backward point fielder.
Tossed up delivery on off, skidding in, Rahim goes for a drive but gets a big inside edge onto the pads.
Starts off with a full delivery on middle, Haque flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Sean Williams is introduced into the attack.
Back of a length delivery angling away from the batsman. Mominul cuts it off his back foot to deepish point and collects a single.
Up and over! Again a short delivery outside off has been slammed over cover-point. The fielder chases it down just before the rope and they take three runs.
An outswinger, just outside off, Rahim gets forward to cover the line and then makes the leave.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! A gentle loosener first up. Short and wide outside off, Rahim stands tall inside the crease and at the last moment guides it past the point fielder for a boundary. This now is the best partnership of the series for Bangladesh.
Bowling change. Kyle Jarvis returns.
Back of a length ball on middle, Haque defends it off the back foot presenting the full face of the bat.
Tiripano bangs it short, MR pulls it to the deep backward square leg fielder. A run added to the total.
Bowls it on middle, Rahim defends it from within the crease.
Full on middle, Haque taps it to the on side and they run a quick single.
Good length delivery outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length outside off, Haque cuts it hard through backward point. The fielder gets a good hand to that otherwise it was racing away to the boundary. Two runs added to the total.

FOUR! Well played! Raza lands it full and around leg, Rahim kneels and nails his sweep shot behind square leg for a boundary. A good end to the over. This pair is now settling down and getting used to the pace of the pitch.
Fullish and on middle, flicked quietly on the leg side.
Flighted delivery around off, turning back in, Rahim goes back inside the crease in defense.
Short and outside off, Mominul goes back and cuts it to deep point for a run.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Mominul drives but finds the cover fielder.
Advances down the track for a big shot but ends up dragging it off the inner half of the bat to mid on.

Full and angling onto his pads. Haque works it around. The ball rolls to fine leg and the batsmen get a single. It brings up the 50-run stand between these two. They need to continue for a longer period of time though.
Bouncer was the reply from the bowler. The batsman easily ducks underneath it.
FOUR! Tiripano bangs it short, Haque quickly hangs back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Errs in line, the batsman has flicked it to the square leg region for a single.
Similar delivery, Mushfiqur does not need to play at those.
Outside off, Rahim shoulders arms to it.
Shortish and outside off, Rahim allows it to spin back in and then taps it down towards backward point for one.
FOUR! Boom! Tossed up ball outside off, landing full and outside off, Rahim latches onto it and drills his drive through cover-point for a boundary.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and on middle, Rahim eases it down through mid on for a run.

Oohhhh... vicious delivery! Big spin back into the batsman from around off. Rahim goes deep inside the crease to play the square cut but the ball keeps on spinning into him an catches him on his gloves. Could have gone anywhere from there.
Back of a length delivery angling in towards the ribs, Rahim tucked it around the corner for a single.
Length delivery on middle, the batsman taps it to the point fielder.
It was served outside off, Mushfiqur lets it go.
On middle, Rahim shows the full face of the bat and drives it straight to mid on.
Drifts on to his pads, MR tucks it to on side.
Full on middle, Rahim drives it straight to the bowler.
FOUR! Easy pickings! This is very short and very wide outside off, Mominul stands back, goes chasing after it and whacks it through covers.
Quicker and angled in on middle, Mominul pushes it down towards mid on.
Fuller on off, played towards the fielder at cover-point.
Flighted and outside off, Mominul leaves it alone this time.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.

Was that dropped? Oh, yes... Short and wide outside off, turning away with extra bounce, Mominul tries to cut but fails to middle his shot. It takes the bottom edge of his bat and Chakabva fails to hold on to the catch. Second life for Mominul.
Full length, landing on middle, Rahim pushes it to the cover fielder.
On middle, Rahim prods forward and defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Length delivery on middle, Rahim defends it from within the crease.
Similar delivery, MR shoulders arms to it.
Outside the off stump channel, the batsman lets it go.
Starts off with a full delivery on his pads, Rahim flicks it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Welcome back for the afternoon session. The players are on the field. Donald Tiripano to bowl first up...
... DAY 1, SECOND SESSION ...

The repair work is on from Mushfiqur Rahim and Mominul Haque. They have survived the initial phase but on a pitch like this, one can never relax. It still is offering good support to the bowlers and Zimbabwe will be eager to take more quick wickets after the break. Do join us in a short while for the post Lunch session at 1210 local (0610 GMT).

Zimbabwe's session! They lost the toss and that came as a blessing in disguise for them. The pitch offered a lot of assistance to their fast bowlers and they capitalized. Kyle Jarvis was outstanding in his spell as he picked up the wickets of both the openers and then Donald Tiripano hunted down the debutant, Mohammad Mithun. Had Mominul Haque not dropped by Brian Chari, it would have been an even better session for the visitors.
Tossed up ball on off, slower in pace, Mominul strides forward in defense. That will be Lunch on Day 1.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Stays back to play it with the spin to covers.

Safe! Mominul survives! Nicely tossed up off spinner around off. It spins away just a bit with plenty of extra bounce. Haque gets forward with a big stride in defense but misses. Chakabva collects the ball and breaks the stumps in no time. He appeals and the square leg umpire goes upstairs. The replays roll in and they show that Haque had dragged his back leg inside the crease just in time.
Stumping appeal is referred upstairs. Zimbabwe look excited. Let's see...
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it with the spin to covers.
Poor delivery, short and wide outside off, Mominul slaps it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Full and wide outside off, Rahim lets it go.
Short of a length delivery on off, MR plays his square cut down in front of gully.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Full on his pads, Rahim has flicked it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Full length delivery on middle, Rahim opens the face of the bat and taps it to the gully fielder.

Nicely bowled. Some extra air this time, it lands full on off and spins back in sharply. Rahim commits himself into the drive but it turns in to take the inside edge. It goes through square leg for one.
Flighted and full outside off, it's driven through the line and goes running past mid off. The fielder eventually chases it down as the batsmen take a couple.
Eases a full ball down to mid on for a sharp single. That will annoy the bowler.
Short in length on off, cut off the back foot to point.
FOUR! Nice timing! A low full toss on off, Mominul takes a stride forward to meet the ball and strokes it elegantly down the ground for a lovely boundary.
Drops it short on middle, Rahim goes back and pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Bowling change. First look of a spinner. Sikandar Raza comes into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, Haque does not need to play at those.
On middle, the batsman hits it straight back to the bowler.
Full length angling across, Haque tries to poke at it but misses it completely.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Haque taps it to the point fielder.
Bouncer from the bowler. Haque easily ducks underneath it.
Physio comes out in the middle to examine Mominul who received a blow on his helmet in the last over. He is checking the jaw area. There's a bowling change now. Donald Tiripano returns.
Length delivery outside off, MR lets it be.
A bit short from the bowler, Rahim hangs back and cuts it through the line. The gully fielder makes a diving stop.
Outside the off stump channel, Rahim shoulders arms to it.
A tad short by Jarvis, Mominul pulls it through fine leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Haque defends it from within the crease.

Nasty blow! Jarvis digs in a short ball and Mominul takes up the challenge to pull it. He, however, is late in his shot and takes a blow on his helmet. That must have hurt but the batsman ain't showing much.
Fullish and shaping back in, Rahim defends it back to end the over.
Slight hold in play. There is a gap between the sightscreen which is causing distraction for the batsman. Quickly sorted out.
Full length ball around off, Mominul tries driving through the line but it comes off from the inside half of the bat and races past the bowler. Three taken as the mid on fielder mops it up.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Lovely placement! Chatara angles a length ball outside off, Mominul leans forward and drives it right through the gap. Does well to find it as he threads it between silly mid off and extra cover. No stopping this one.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Mominul gets across to defend but it takes the inside half of his bat.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A tad full from Jarvis, MR pushes it through point for a couple of runs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Rahim defends it from within the crease.
Full on middle, Rahim tries to flick it but the ball rolls to the mid on fielder.

Lucky escape for Rahim this time. It was dished full outside off, Rahim pokes at it and the ball just falls short of Taylor at second slip. It sneaks past him and Hamilton from first slip chases it down. Two runs added to the total.
Play and a miss. Length delivery angling away. Rahim pushes at it tamely and misses.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Mominul tries to play the square cut but misses. Yet another maiden by Chatara, his seventh in the 8 overs bowled so far. Very disciplined.
A silly mid off in place.
Length delivery on middle and off, Haque gets on the back foot and defends it down on the off side.
Angles it across the left-hander, outside off and on a length, Mominul covers the line and shoulders arms.
Keeps it full and on off, Mominul stays back and opens the face of his bat to push it towards covers.
Pitches it up and around off, Mominul is drawn forward in defense.
Good length delivery on off, Mominul remains back footed and defends it down in the direction of cover-point.
Back of a length delivery, MR defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery on middle, Rahim taps it to the point fielder.
Jarvis goes short this time, Haque pulls it to fine leg. They run a single.
Short and wide outside off, Haque cuts it hard but straight to the backward point fielder.
Straighter in line, Rahim tries blocking with a straight bat but it takes the inside edge and runs down to fine leg for a run.
Outside the off stump channel, Rahim lets it leave.
Kyle Jarvis is back on.
Full on middle, the batsman tucks it to mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Mominul does not need to play at those.
Back of a length delivery on off, Haque defends it from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside the off stump channel, Haque lets it leave.
Length delivery on middle, Rahim taps it to the off side.
A length delivery outside off, Rahim strokes it through covers and picks up a couple of runs.
Drops it full this time, Rahim drives but finds the mid off fielder.
Goes wide of the crease and delivers an inswinger on off, Rahim does well to block it from the crease.
Tiripano mixing it up nicely. Lets out an outswinger this time, outside off and shaping away, Rahim allows it  through.
Keeps probing in the channel outside. An inswinger this time and Rahim offers no shot. This one comes back in by just to go closely past the off pole.
Bowls it on a good length outside off, staying low, Rahim keeps himself away from the line of the delivery and makes a leave.
It was dished outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Mominul defends it within the crease.
Haque has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

DROPPED! Mominul gets a life. It's served wide outside off, the batsman cuts hard towards backward point. Fails to keep it down and Chari present there fails to hold on to the catch after stretching to his left to grab the ball in the first attempt. That should have been taken. Haque now needs to be careful. He is trying to be too flashy at this stage.

Uppish but safe! A full length ball around off, Mominul walks across the stumps with an attempted flick shot but closes the face of the bat early. It flies off the leading edge but falls short of mid off.
Back of length delivery on middle, Haque defends it off the front foot.
Another leave outside the off stump to end the over.
Good leave. An inswinger, landing outside off on a length, Rahim takes his front leg forward to cover his stumps and then shoulders arms.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
In line of the stumps, Mominul pushes it back past the bowler for a run.
Fullish and outside off, Mominul drives through the line but finds the fielder.
Angling away from the batsman, a bit on the shorter side, Mominul pushes inside the line and misses.

The replays of 12.6 has just been shown. There was no inside edge and it was hitting the top of middle stump. So, it would have been umpire's call in any case. Zimbabwe didn't take the DRS and it was a fair decision.
Length ball on middle, Haque covers the line and blocks it to the leg side. Called a no ball for overstepping.
Drinks.

Shout for an lbw! A delivery shaping back into the batsman from around off, Rahim shuffles across and forward to defend but gets a faint inside edge onto the back pad. They put in an unsuccessful appeal.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to covers.
Angling into the batsman from around off, Rahim blocks it from the back foot.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Change of ends for Tendai Chatara.
Haque defends it presenting the full face of the bat.
Haque defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off. Mominul easily leaves it.
Full length delivery on middle, Rahim pushes it through covers. They cross for a run as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Lovely delivery that. Length delivery angling in. A brave leave by Rahim and it goes vert closely past the off stump.
Mushfiqur Rahim arrives with Bangladesh in an early spot of bother.

OUT! Zimbabwe all over Bangladesh like a rash! What on earth was going in the mind of the debutant? Poor, once again very poor from a Bangla batsman. Tiripano delivers a very full delivery wide outside off. It could have been left alone but Mithun chases it away from his body and tries to squeeze it through point. Needless, completely needless. The ball takes the outside edge of his bat and flies straight into the hands of Taylor at second slip, who takes it gleefully. A duck on Test debut for Mithun. Zimbabwe making a statement. They want a series win.
Gets forward to a length ball and offers a solid front foot defense.

Bowls it around off, some extra bounce, Mominul once again shuffles across and this time defends it from the splice of his bat. He is moving too much across the sticks here and is exposing his middle and leg stumps.
A length delivery leaving the batsman, Mominul shuffles across the stumps before letting it through.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Mominul defends it from the crease.

FOUR! A cracking shot! This is what Liton was attempting but got out. A flick shot by Mominul Haque. He gets a full length delivery on off, uses his wrists and with good balance clips it through the gap at mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Mominul shows patience as he lets it through to the keeper. Too far out to trouble the batsman.
Back of a length delivery on middle, the batsman defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, Mithun shoulders arms to it.
Leg byes. Drifts on to his pads, Mominul tries to flick it, but misses it completely and the ball rolls it to fine leg. They run for a single.
Full on middle, batsman drives it straight to the mid on fielder.
No ball! It was dished way outside off. Easy leave for the batsman. Umpires signals a no ball.
Length delivery outside off, the batsman lets it be.
FOUR! A loosener to start from the bowler. It was short and wide outside off, Haque cuts it hard through backward point and the ball races away to the boundary.
Bowling change. Zimbabwe have opted for an extra seamer in this Test match and it's Donald Tiripano. His turn to roll his arm now.
Too full and on middle, worked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Debutant Mohammad Mithun walks in next.

OUT! Another one falls! Poor, extremely poor execution of the shot by Liton Das. Jarvis roars in delight. He angles in a length ball on middle and Das spots the opportunity to play the flick shot. He gets it away from the middle of his bat too but fails to keep it down. Brandon Mavuta manning the mid-wicket region makes no mistake and Bangladesh lose their second wicket. The umpire quickly checks upstairs for the no ball but Kyle is fine with his front foot landing. Perfect start for Zimbabwe after losing the toss.
Angling into the batsman, it lands on a good length and straightens. Das keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Pitches it full this time but the line is quite wide outside off. It seams away after landing as Das makes a leave.
Good length delivery landing around off, Das keeps his weight on the back foot and blocks it safely.
A touch short in length and outside off, Das punches it from the back foot but finds the cover fielder. Not an ideal length on this surface, you got to pitch it up as there is ample movement.
Haque has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifts on his pads, Liton tries to tuck it fine but misses. It hits the pads and they scamper for a leg bye.
Just a tad short, the batsman pounces onto it and punches it through point for a couple of runs.
Short and wide outside off, Das cuts it straight to the backward point fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, the batsman lets it leave.
Length delivery on middle, Liton defends it with a straight bat.
Shortish on off, defended down safely to end the over, a wicket maiden.
Not a great attempt first ball. Jarvis bowls it short and wide, Mominul throws his bat at it and gets beaten.
Mominul Haque is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Chakabva takes a stunner! Kayes departs for a 16-ball duck. A good beginning for Zimbabwe. Both their pacers were probing in good areas and finally, there is some success. After bowling an outswinger on the previous ball, Jarvis delivers a length ball around off and gets it to straighten from there. Kayes tries to defend it by bringing down a straight bat but it kisses the inside part of his bat and flies behind. Chakabva shows excellent reflexes as he dives across full length to his right to take a ripper. Just to complete the formality, they appeal and the finger goes up. Kayes starts to walk. A dismal outing yet again for him after a great ODI series.

Play and a miss! Jarvis lures the batsman with an overpitched delivery outside off. It nips away after landing as Kayes attempts to play the cover drive. Ends up missing it badly. Kayes is yet to open his account.
Another delivery served in the line around off, some extra bounce as well, Kayes takes his bottom hand off the handle as he blocks.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, Kayes gets behind the line and defends it to the off side.
Wide and short outside off, the batsman tried to cut hard but missed it completely.
Bowls it full on middle, Das defends it off front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, Das lets it be.
Back of a length on middle, the batsman defends it with a straight bat.
Full on middle, Liton pushes it straight to mid on.
FOUR BYES! Errs in length, Chatara. Full and wide down leg and ball races away to the fine leg fence as the batsman fails to flick.
Too full in length on off, Liton gets forward and pushes it past the cover-point fielder for a single.
Digs in a short ball on off, Liton pulls over mid-wicket. Doesn't quite time his shot but will still get a couple of runs.
Delivers a good length ball outside off, another leave made by Liton.
Gets one to skids back in with extra bounce, Das fails to defend and is hit high on the back leg.
Lovely outward movement. Full and just outside off, curling away after landing. Liton watchfully lets it be.
Good length delivery outside off, moving away, Das has nothing to do with it.
Length delivery outside off, the batsman offers no shot to it.
Full length from Chatara, the batsman pushes at it but gets the inside half of the bat onto his pads.
Similar delivery, the batsman leaves it.
Length delivery outside off. Imrul shoulders arms to it.
Full outside off, Kayes pushes it towards point.
Good length delivery outside off. Batsman lets it leave.
This one shapes back in from around off, Liton tries defending but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Beaten! Outside off, nipping away, Das pushes inside the line and misses.
Strides forward to a length ball and gently pushes it through the gap at covers for a couple of runs.
In the channel outside off, Das lifts his bat and allows it through again. Called a no ball for overstepping.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it safely.
Wide! Wild delivery, wayyy outside off, Das allows it through.
First runs for Bangladesh! Straighter delivery, Das tries flicking it through mid-wicket but it takes the inside edge and travels to fine leg for a brace.

NOT OUT! Daylight between bat and ball. A rare wrong decision by Richard Kettleborough. Jarvis serves a back of a length delivery outside off, it shapes away just a bit after landing and Das is caught pushing inside the line from the crease. As soon as it goes past his willow, Chakabva catches it and they all appeal in unison. The finger also goes up but Liton is very confident as he takes the DRS. The replays roll in and Snicko detects no spike.
Liton Das has been given out caught behind. He immediately signals for the DRS. Let's see...
Good length delivery outside off, Kayes covers the line and shoulders arms.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it safely.
Beaten on the inside edge. Very full delivery, outside off, Imrul tries driving but it straightens after landing to beat the inside edge.
Superb delivery. Leaving the batsman outside off, Kayes watches the line closely before making a leave.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. An inswinger landing on a length around leg, Kayes fails to work it away and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire. The replays show that it pitched outside leg. A good early decision by the umpire.
Starts his spell with a fuller length ball on off, Kayes looks to play the cover drive but it takes the inside edge and rolls to mid-wicket.
Tendai Chatara to share the new cherry from the other end.
Excellent line. A length ball around off, Liton presents a straight bat in defense. A maiden first up by Jarvis.
Keeps bowling the one which nips away after landing. Lands this delivery on middle and Das tucks it off his pads. Finds the mid-wicket fielder.

Edged but short! Another outswinger by Jarvis. He serves it close to the off stump line and this time Liton has to play at it. He pushes inside the line and gets a soft outside edge behind. It falls in front of the third slip fielder.
An outswinger by Jarvis but the line is quite wide outside off. Das lets it be. Watchful.
Bowls it on a good length and this one is wide outside off, Liton has an easy leave to make.
Right on the money straightway and the batsman is equally up to the task. A fuller length ball on off, Das is forward with a straight bat as he defends it back.

Time to get underway! Liton Das and Imrul Kayes are the openers for Bangladesh. It's going to be Kyle Jarvis to kick off proceedings with the new cherry. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Toss - The coin falls in favour of the home team and BANGLADESH WILL BAT! As expected, they have made three changes to their playing XI. Mustafizur Rahman is back while Mohammad Mithun and Khaled Mahmud are making their debuts. Zimbabwe have made just one change, Wellington Masakadza makes way for Donald Tiripano.
Pitch - There is a fair bit of dry grass on the surface and it's hard in nature. The pitch will start taking turn as the match progresses and batting first appears to be a better bet.

Welcome, folks! Zimbabwe did the unthinkable in Sylhet by outclassing Bangladesh in the first Test match to take a series lead. They will be delighted after registering their first win in this format in five years. Now, they have a golden chance to win an away Test series which will be quite a rare feat for the African minnows. Can they do it? Well, only time will tell. They will be up against a hurt Bangladesh unit. The hosts have built a reputation at home which was challenged and Zimbabwe should be ready for a backlash. All in all, we are expecting a cracking Test match in Mirpur. Stay with us for more updates.
